# Boardroom CXO

> Executive search firm for CXO and senior leadership roles in India and the UAE, with the deepest network in retail and jewellery. Places CEOs, CFOs, CMOs, CHROs and sales leaders, headhunted from competitor companies and benchmarked on real pay data, not sourced from job-board databases. Also publishes Boardroom Moves, a record of senior leadership moves in India, and Inside the Boardroom, weekly stories of Indian business leaders.

Boardroom CXO is based in Surat, India, and serves clients across India and the UAE. It works in five sectors: retail and jewellery (the deepest network), consumer and D2C, financial services, manufacturing, and technology. The firm's differentiators: direct headhunting of passive candidates who are not job-hunting, mapping what a role pays across the category and city before the budget is set, and verifying actual take-home pay (bank credit) rather than reported CTC, a known gap at legacy retail and jewellery brands.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://boardroomcxo.com/): positioning, roles filled, a live compensation-benchmarking tool by role, store count and city tier, and a static 2025-26 pay table
- [Executive Search](https://boardroomcxo.com/executive-search): CEO and MD, CFO, CMO, sales, retail and business development, and CHRO searches across the five sectors; how a search works and what it costs
- [About Us](https://boardroomcxo.com/about-us): firm history, founder CA Ketul Patel, placement track record and team
- [Case Studies](https://boardroomcxo.com/case-studies): real placement outcomes, including CMO, CFO, sales and operations leadership hires
- [Resources](https://boardroomcxo.com/resources): field articles on executive hiring, compensation and leadership
- [Get Featured](https://boardroomcxo.com/get-featured): submit a leadership move for Boardroom Moves or pitch a story for Inside the Boardroom
- [Schedule a Call](https://boardroomcxo.com/schedule-a-call): contact and booking
- [Privacy Policy](https://boardroomcxo.com/privacy-policy): how Boardroom CXO and Boardroom Moves handle personal data

## Boardroom Moves

- [Boardroom Moves](https://boardroomcxo.com/moves): senior leadership appointments in India across sectors, announced on the Boardroom CXO LinkedIn page and recorded here, with a page for each leader (new role, company, previous role, date). The weekly Brief rounds up 5 to 6 leaders who moved that week, every Thursday. Featured placement is arranged with the leader or their company, and the leader sees the write-up before it goes live. The weekly Brief is not paid for
- [Monthly report, October 2026](https://boardroomcxo.com/moves/report/2026-10): the senior leadership moves tracked that month, by function and sector, with a CSV download
- [Move pages sitemap](https://boardroomcxo.com/sitemap-moves.xml): machine-readable list of every move page

- [Marketing and CMO search](https://boardroomcxo.com/marketing-leadership-hiring): CMOs, CGOs, performance marketing leads and brand leaders
- [Sales and retail leadership search](https://boardroomcxo.com/sales-leadership-hiring): store managers through area, regional and national sales heads
- [Finance and CFO search](https://boardroomcxo.com/finance-leadership-hiring): CFOs, finance heads, treasurers and financial controllers, including pre-IPO and cross-border mandates
- [HR and people leadership search](https://boardroomcxo.com/hr-leadership-hiring): CHROs, heads of talent acquisition, people operations and learning leaders

## UAE

- [Executive search for UAE consulting and business-setup firms](https://boardroomcxo.com/uae-consulting-hiring): marketing, business development and engineering leaders for UAE consulting, business-setup and corporate service firms, hired locally or sourced from India

## Hiring field notes

- [Solitario's Netflix Moment Exposes a Marketing Hiring Gap](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-solitario-cultural-relevance-marketing-leadership): why a Netflix brand integration that spiked Solitario Diamonds' traffic reveals most jewellery and D2C brands have hired the wrong kind of marketing leader: for paid reach, not cultural relevance
- [Aukera Raised ₹90 Cr: Inside India's Lab-Grown Diamond Race](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-aukera-lab-grown-diamond-category-race): what Aukera's back-to-back funding rounds and a legacy conglomerate's entry signal about the leadership talent lab-grown diamond jewellery brands need to scale
- [Why the Best Performance Marketers in Jewelry Are Not on Naukri](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-performance-marketer-jewelry): on the thin, non-job-hunting pool of marketers with real ROAS experience in the jewellery price range of ₹5,000–60,000
- [The Hidden Comp Gap: Why Jewelry Brands Keep Losing Candidates at the Offer Stage](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-hidden-comp-gap): field data on the gap between documented CTC and actual take-home pay at legacy jewellery/retail brands

## For leaders: announcing a move and being found

- [How to Announce a New CXO Appointment in India](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-announce-cxo-appointment-india): How to announce a new CXO appointment in India: the stock exchange filing, the company post, the LinkedIn post and the outlets that cover moves.
- [What a Search Firm Sees When It Googles You](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-what-search-firm-sees-when-it-googles-you): What a search firm checks about senior candidates online: your LinkedIn against your CV, a Google search of your name, and what you post.
- [Executive PR in India: Agency, Paid Profile or Announcement Feature](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-executive-pr-india-options): Executive PR in India compared: PR agency, paid profile, announcement feature or your own LinkedIn. What each gives and how to spot a paid profile.
- [How a New Leader Gets Covered by Indian Business Media](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-new-leader-business-media-coverage-india): How to get featured in business media as a new CEO or CXO in India: what counts as news, which outlets cover what, how to pitch and guest columns.
- [Your First 90 Days as a New CMO in Retail or D2C: the Visibility Part](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-new-cmo-first-90-days-visibility): A new CMO's first 90 days in retail or D2C, visibility only: the announcement, LinkedIn, being seen inside, posting, trade press and your name search.

## Inside the Boardroom: leadership profiles

- [Inside the Boardroom](https://boardroomcxo.com/inside-the-boardroom): index of every story, newest first
- [Saugata Gupta Bought Founders, Not D2C Teams. Then He Kept Marico Out.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-saugata-gupta-marico-d2c): how Marico CEO Saugata Gupta bought digital-first brands Beardo, Just Herbs and Plix instead of building them in-house, let their founders run them independently, and saw the portfolio exit FY26 above ₹1,100 crore in annual run rate, with Plix's revenue doubling to ₹864 crore
- [Sanjiv Puri Let Go of ITC's Hotels. ITC Still Made ₹20,286 Crore.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sanjiv-puri-itc-hotels): how Sanjiv Puri moved ITC's hotels, about 5% of revenue but over 20% of capital spending, into a separate company in a demerger announced in July 2023, kept a 40% stake despite investor pushback, and how ITC earned ₹20,286 crore in FY26 while ITC Hotels grew profit 29% and paid its first dividend
- [Rajiv Bajaj Walked Away From Scooters. Then He Rebuilt the Chetak Name.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-rajiv-bajaj-chetak): how Rajiv Bajaj took Bajaj Auto out of scooters in December 2009 to focus on motorcycles, against his father's wishes, and how the Chetak name returned as an electric scooter in 2019 that sold 8 lakh units and took 22.5% of India's electric two-wheeler market in January to June 2026
- [Jayen Mehta Took Amul to America Without Exporting a Litre of Milk From India](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-jayen-mehta-amul): how Amul, owned by 3.6 million Gujarat dairy farmers through GCMMF, crossed ₹1 lakh crore in brand turnover in FY26 without ever listing, and how managing director Jayen Mehta took Amul fresh milk to the US through a partnership with the Michigan Milk Producers Association instead of exporting milk from India
- [R C Bhargava: Maruti's Share Hit a 13-Year Low. It Still Sold a Record 24 Lakh Cars.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-rc-bhargava-maruti-suzuki): how Maruti Suzuki's passenger vehicle market share fell to a 13-year low of 39.26% in FY26 as buyers moved to SUVs, while it sold a record 24.22 lakh vehicles on revenue of ₹1,83,382 crore, and why chairman R C Bhargava told analysts not to harp on market share
- [Ashok Vaswani: The RBI Banned Kotak on His 115th Day. He Had It Lifted.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-ashok-vaswani-kotak-mahindra-bank): how the RBI barred Kotak Mahindra Bank from onboarding customers online and issuing new credit cards on 24 April 2024, Ashok Vaswani's 115th day as CEO, over IT failures found before he joined, and how he fixed them until the curbs were lifted on 12 February 2025, day 409
- [Falguni Nayar: Nykaa's Stock Fell, Its Profit Grew Nearly Tenfold](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-falguni-nayar-nykaa): how Nykaa listed 79% above its issue price in November 2021, fell out of India's top 100 companies within a year, and how Falguni Nayar kept growing it until profit rose from ₹21 crore in FY23 to ₹204 crore in FY26 on revenue above ₹10,000 crore
- [Varun Alagh: When Honasa Fell 40%, He Bought More](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-varun-alagh-honasa-mamaearth): how Mamaearth began in 2016 with six baby products, how its parent Honasa fell 40% to ₹223 after its first loss as a listed company in November 2024, and how co-founder Varun Alagh bought shares twice, ₹50 crore the second time, before profit and the stock recovered
- [Gaurav Singh Kushwaha: BlueStone's First Profit Came Without a Turnaround](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-gaurav-singh-kushwaha-bluestone): how BlueStone listed at ₹510, below its ₹517 issue price, after a ₹219 crore loss, and how Gaurav Singh Kushwaha took FY26 to its first full-year profit, ₹26 crore on ₹2,441 crore revenue, without a pivot
- [Puneet Chhatwal: He Grew the Taj by Owning Less of It](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-puneet-chhatwal-ihcl-taj): how Puneet Chhatwal took over Taj Hotels after seven straight years of losses, raised ₹4,000 crore mid-pandemic, signed hotels without owning them, and took IHCL's profit past ₹2,000 crore for the first time
- [Noel Tata: The Job He Didn't Get, and the One He Built Instead](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-noel-tata-trent-zudio): how Noel Tata, passed over for chairman of Tata Sons in 2011, went back to running Westside, built Zudio into 963 of Trent's 1,286 stores, and in 2024 became chairman of Tata Trusts
- [M P Ahammed: How a Coconut Trader Built India's Largest Jeweller](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-mp-ahammed-malabar-gold): how M P Ahammed sold dried coconut for 12 years, opened a single jewellery shop in Kozhikode in 1993, and grew by selling debentures to investors in the Gulf into Malabar Gold, now 445 stores in 14 countries
- [Gopal Vittal: He Let 40 Million Customers Leave Airtel on Purpose](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-gopal-vittal-airtel-arpu): how Gopal Vittal, after free mobile data cut Airtel's profit 76.5% in a year, let 40 million low-spending customers go and built the network for customers who would pay more
- [Anish Shah: The Outsider Who Fixed Mahindra's ₹5,200 Crore Problem](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-anish-shah-mahindra-turnaround): how Anish Shah, the first non-family group CEO at Mahindra in 75 years, took over after a 98% profit fall, hit the group's five-year RoE target in eighteen months, and took second place in Indian cars from Hyundai
- [Costs Were Rising Everywhere. Sameer Khetarpal Cut Domino's Prices Anyway.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sameer-khetarpal-dominos-india): how Sameer Khetarpal held Domino's India prices flat for two years while costs rose, backed Domino's own delivery fleet, and saw profit jump 190% by the September 2025 quarter, helped by a one-time gain
- [He Ran India's Biggest Luggage Company. Then He Bought the Rival One-Tenth Its Size.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sudhir-jatia-safari-industries): how Sudhir Jatia resigned from VIP Industries in 2010, bought 56.55% of Safari Industries for ₹29 crore in 2011, and grew sales from ₹70 crore to over ₹2,047 crore and market share from 2% to 23%
- [Venu Nair Took the Job Nobody Wanted at Shoppers Stop. He Turned It Around in About a Year.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-venu-nair-shoppers-stop): how Venu Nair took the top job at Shoppers Stop in November 2020 with malls half empty and revenue heading for a 44% fall, kept a ₹450 crore cost-savings drive on track, and turned the company net-cash within about a year
- [Verghese Kurien Packed His Bags to Leave Anand. He Stayed Fifty Years and Built Amul.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-verghese-kurien-amul-cooperative): how a 27-year-old engineer who planned to leave a government creamery in Anand the moment his bond ended instead spent fifty years building the farmer-owned co-operative that became Amul, backing the world's first buffalo milk spray dryer in 1955 and running the National Dairy Development Board for 33 years, with Amul now owned by 3.6 million farmers and crossing ₹1 lakh crore in brand turnover in 2025-26
- [Bharat Puri Heard About the Cadbury Worms From TV News. He Fixed It in Three Months.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-bharat-puri-cadbury-worm-crisis): how Cadbury India Managing Director Bharat Puri responded to the October 2003 Dairy Milk worm contamination crisis by having his sales team verify the product, rebuilding the packaging into a sealed double wrap by January 2004 at Cadbury's own cost, and facing the media himself rather than relying on the FDA's clean chit for its factories, with sales back within six months
- [Everyone Said Royal Enfield Was Finished. Siddhartha Lal Asked for Two Years.](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-siddhartha-lal-royal-enfield): how a 26-year-old Siddhartha Lal took charge of a dying Royal Enfield in 2000, spent four years fixing the product before touching the market, then deliberately shrank Eicher Motors from 15 businesses to two, a bet that took Royal Enfield past ten lakh motorcycles sold in FY25
- [C K Venkataraman: How Tanishq Fixed Years of Being Wrong About India](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-ck-venkataraman-tanishq-jewelry): how Tanishq spent its early years guessing wrong about the Indian gold buyer, and how C K Venkataraman, who ran the jewellery division from 2005 to 2019 and later became Titan's managing director, helped turn that lesson into India's leading organised jewellery business, over ₹46,000 crore in FY25
- [Sunil D'Souza Turned Down Tata's FMCG Job, Then Built It From Tea and Salt](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sunil-dsouza-tata-consumer-products): why Sunil D'Souza initially declined the Tata Consumer Products role over its lack of direction, then took it once he understood the ambiguity was a build mandate, and grew the business to ₹20,290 crore in revenue
- [Ramesh Chauhan Sold Thums Up to Build Bisleri From Scratch](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-ramesh-chauhan-bisleri-thums-up): how Ramesh Chauhan sold India's dominant cola brand to Coca-Cola in 1993 and redeployed the capital into solving bottled water's distribution economics, building Bisleri into a category the brand name is now used generically to describe
- [Suresh Narayanan: The MD Who Walked Into the Maggi Ban](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-suresh-narayanan-maggi-crisis): how Suresh Narayanan took the Nestlé India MD role the same year 38,000 tonnes of Maggi were destroyed, and rebuilt the business to ₹20,000 crore
- [Sudhir Sitapati: Why He Left HUL's Safest Seat for Godrej](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sudhir-sitapati-godrej-leadership): why Sudhir Sitapati left Hindustan Unilever's management committee for the smaller Godrej Consumer Products, and what his tenure there, which ended with his resignation in August 2026, reveals about testing leadership judgment without institutional scaffolding
- [Shailesh Jejurikar: P&G's First Indian-Origin CEO in 187 Years](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-shailesh-jejurikar-pg-leadership): how a 36-year, single-employer career that ran through hard postings in East Africa and Asia culminated in Shailesh Jejurikar becoming the first Indian-origin CEO in Procter & Gamble's 187-year history
- [Sanjiv Mehta: The HUL Leader Who Never Forgot Bhopal](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-sanjiv-mehta-crisis-leadership): how Sanjiv Mehta grew Hindustan Unilever's value more than 4x, closed the GSK Consumer merger, and doubled women in leadership, shaped by lessons from the Bhopal gas tragedy
- [Refused to Blink: The Boardroom Lesson Behind Marico's War With Hindustan Lever](https://boardroomcxo.com/article-marico-refused-to-blink): how Marico's founder rejected a 1999 buyout offer from Hindustan Lever and fought a four-front category war instead, a case study in founder-led leadership under existential pressure
